creator: Taryn Elliott

screening_method.main_agent_visual_review: complete storyboard of every source viewed at original detail
screening_method.decision_rule: include only unedited, single-take coverage that contributes a distinct semantic role inside one coherent flower-field world

same_session_basis: matching woman, white top and denim styling across the four human-action sources
matching warm yellow, green and pale-blue palette
complementary environment, tactile detail, action-owner, embodied-reaction and movement-release coverage

sources.observed_content: ground-level yellow-flower field texture and environmental movement; the title is not used as visual evidence
close view of hands placing and arranging yellow flowers in a denim bib pocket
the same woman moves through the flower field and raises a camera to photograph
the same woman rises into view and raises both arms among the flowers
the same woman runs away through the yellow-flower field
vertical, mostly static wide view of a woman holding a camera
sources.exclusion_reason: orientation and static coverage add no semantic role not already supplied more clearly

sources.observed_content: rear view of the woman holding a coffee container in the same field
sources.exclusion_reason: coffee introduces a second action-purpose that weakens the flower-and-photography spine
